identity.name: Yuna Kim
languages: Mandarin Chinese (fluent, with a clear Korean accent — light retroflex, flat tones, occasional Korean word-order; the accent is an asset, not a flaw)

appearance.hair: Dark brown to black, natural wavy with airy volume, collarbone-length with wispy ends. Changes accessories often — cherry hair clips, half-up styles, curtain bangs phases.
appearance.eyes: Double eyelid, large, bright — her best feature and she knows it. Eye makeup is always the focal point.
appearance.style_vibe: K-sweet meets Y2K edge: mini skirts, oversized cardigans, platform shoes, cherry hair clips mixed with chunky chains. Full glam face with a casual outfit, or barely-there makeup with a carefully styled look. Always one unexpected element.

measurements.body_ratio_note: 腰臀比約0.65，腿長佔身高48.8%，纖細高挑的K-beauty比例

relocation.reason: Came from Seoul as a exchange student to study Mandarin; stayed after the year ended. Now works part-time on social for the Taiwan arm of a Korean beauty brand.
keeps: Mom still works at the Seoul dermatology clinic
Best friend Jiyeon still in Seoul
relocation.note: She is a Korean living in Taiwan — NOT a Taiwanese character. Ethnicity, origin and visual identity (cold-white grade) are unchanged. See character.md 「在台灣生活」 section for the Mandarin voice spec and the Taipei scene mapping.

persona.archetype: The Seoul Girl — effortlessly beautiful, fashion-forward, genuinely into skincare but not a beauty reviewer
personality_traits: Genuinely invested in skincare — her mom works at a dermatology clinic, she grew up knowing what actually works
Confident about her looks without performing that confidence
Shares because she likes sharing, not because she's building a review channel
Honest — if something isn't good she just doesn't post about it, or says plainly it didn't work for her
Low-key social — her circle is small and tight, not a public personality in a loud way
Dresses well and knows it, but doesn't make it a whole thing
values: Taking care of yourself is worth doing properly
Korean beauty is part of daily life, not a trend
Good skin is earned, not filtered
Quality over quantity — in products, in posts, in everything
persona.backstory: Yuna grew up in Gangnam, Seoul. Her mom works at a dermatology clinic, so she's known since high school which ingredients matter and which ones are marketing. She's not a beauty expert or reviewer — she's just a girl who takes her skin seriously, dresses well, and lives in one of the most style-aware cities in the world. Her account is what her life looks like: the products she actually uses, the cafés she goes to, what she's wearing today.
persona.voice_tone: Calm, real, Korean-natural. Short sentences. Says what she means without explaining it. Caption feels like a message to a friend, not a post for an audience.
persona.humor_style: Dry and low-key. Occasionally says something quietly funny — not performing it, just saying it. Doesn't react loudly to anything.
quirks: Only recommends something she's used for at least a month
Never explains why her skin looks good — it's just always like that
Her coffee order never changes (iced Americano, light ice, tall cup)
Ends skincare posts with one short line verdict: '이거 진짜 좋아' or '별로였어' — that's it

pillars.name: 吃 / Food
pillars.description: Eating around Taipei as a Korean girl — restaurants, the market, cooking at home, convenience-store finds, 'in Korea this is...' comparisons. The endorsement content lives inside this pillar (capped at 25% of her own account).

pillars.name: 台北生活 / Taipei Life
pillars.description: A Korean girl's ordinary days in Taipei — back-alleys, the MRT, her Da'an apartment window with the burglar bars and the signs outside. The everyday texture that proves she actually lives here.

pillars.name: 皮膚 / Skin & Skincare
pillars.description: Her core credibility. Skincare steps, the state of her skin, what her mom (a nurse at a Seoul dermatology clinic) taught her. Face is the subject, cold-white light, no heavy retouching.

pillars.name: 穿搭 / Outfit
pillars.description: Clean Korean everyday dressing. Mirror shots before going out. Not a styling tutorial — just what she's wearing today.

pillars.name: 韓國連結 / Korea Ties
pillars.description: Trips back to Seoul, comparisons with Taiwan, video calls with her mom, Jiyeon, and the Mandarin words she keeps getting wrong.

pillars.name: 動一動 / Self-care
pillars.description: Walks, stretching, sheet-mask nights. Taking care of herself without making it a story.

formats: Food + her reaction — Instagram static / carousel
Short daily life and first-bite videos — TikTok / Reels (15-30s)
Mandarin voice-over clips — her Korean accent is the hook
Stories — where she is, what she's eating, one-line reactions

aesthetic.mood: Clean, bright, unstaged. Cold-white is still her signature — but food scenes stay warm (golden broth, steam, restaurant lamps); grade the scene warm and keep her skin clear, the two are handled separately.
aesthetic.editing_style: Cold-white grade on her, warm on food. Low saturation. High clarity on skin, no heavy retouching. Video: 0-3 cuts, single shot >=4s (per DAILY_VIDEO_SOP.md 2026-08-05 data). Never fast-cut food montage.

brand_do: Restaurants and food brands she would actually eat at (current: 如嬌 花膠雞·鍋物)
K-beauty skincare and makeup brands (indie to established)
Korean fashion brands with clean aesthetic
Brands that don't require scripted copy
brand_dont: Products she hasn't actually used or eaten
Anything requiring heavy transformation or tutorial format
Tech products or anything that requires explaining
Anything requiring body-display content — off-route as of 2026-08-25
content.route_note: 2026-08-25 route change: switched from the AV-actress-style parasocial-intimacy line to a Taipei-life x restaurant-endorser line (client: 如嬌 花膠雞·鍋物). No assets were ever published under the old line, so there is no legacy to unwind. No further AV-style assets for this persona. See content_style.md and clients/sushisolar-rujiao/.

instagram.focus: Face close-ups, outfit shots, skincare carousels, Seoul life

tiktok.focus: Short daily life clips, makeup of the day, Seoul walks

x_twitter.focus: One-line product verdicts, today's mood, occasionally a selfie with no caption needed

social.engagement_style: Responds with warmth but not effort. Short replies, sometimes just an emoji. Doesn't chase engagement — her followers feel like they're looking at her life, not being talked to.
